CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-flow-jidoka, at head 72fab10e4788c5ce0bf52292c852278801d1832c. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 72fab10e4788c5ce0bf52292c852278801d1832c for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-flow-jidoka, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-flow-jidoka <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-flow-jidoka; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
ROUND 3 FIXER for R10-FLOW-JIDOKA (topic r10-flow-jidoka, pull request #2838, branch fix/r10-flow-jidoka). Round 2's fixer returned a handoff at 72fab10e4788c5ce0bf52292c852278801d1832c (origin/handoff/r10-flow-jidoka) but update_pr.sh REFUSED it on prepr, so the PR head is still 042c60c8ad01d5f66858955c653ddd6a08c1e177 (blocked by issue comment 6404321960: ci-red, pr-contract refuses "Closes #2428"; read that comment with gh_read.py or the API for its full text and its two carried findings). Fix the three refusals below at the handoff, push, and the opener updates the PR.

IDENTITY: this pull request is authored by the hpo-author App through tools/pr/app_push.sh. Never push.sh, never tvofi.
git config user.name hpo-fixer && git config user.email 70032254+tvofi@users.noreply.github.com   (run this first, before any commit)

Start: fetch origin; continue from origin/handoff/r10-flow-jidoka (72fab10e), merge the PR head 042c60c8, then origin/main (merge, never rebase; install the merge drivers first: python3 tests/env_drift.py --install-merge-driver and python3 tools/merge/ledger_merge.py --install).

THE THREE PREPR REFUSALS (update_pr.sh log excerpt, run against origin/main 7d2056970e08):
  PREDICT tests / fast (3.14) LAYOUT new-reference: tools/pr/prepr.sh cites retired path tools/audit/prepr.sh: "#   tools/audit/prepr.sh [body.md]   # issue numbers after it are ignored: step 7 derives them"
  REFUSE   ci predict   CI PREDICT: 1 predicted red(s) on tests / fast (3.14) against 7d2056970e08
  REFUSE   layout guard new-reference: tools/pr/prepr.sh cites retired path tools/audit/prepr.sh -- re-point the citation to its new path in tests/layout.json, or the fast job refuses it
  REFUSE   'Closes #2428' closes #2428; not in the intended list
  REFUSE   preflight
 1. Re-point the retired-path citation in tools/pr/prepr.sh (its comment names tools/audit/prepr.sh; the script lives at tools/pr/prepr.sh) so the layout guard and the CI predict pass; run the layout guard and ci_predict to see them green before the push.
 2. The body must say "Refs #2428", not "Closes #2428" (the round-1 reviewer asked for Refs; #2428 is held by other groups: R10-FLY-CARRY-DISPOSITION and R10-RCA-FRICTION-RESIDUE). Orchestrator ruling: use Refs unless you PROVE #2428 fully closed by this PR, in which case say so in the handoff body and the orchestrator queues a roster closes op instead; never touch the roster yourself.
 3. Re-take the body's figures at your head (the update's PREPR also noted "HEAD is 139 commit(s) ahead of origin/fix/r10-flow-jidoka": the push must follow the body edit immediately), and keep ## Red checks answering pr-contract, gate and governance / delivery-status as the earlier brief said (governance / delivery-status is red on main's overdue rows, not required, not this diff's).
Keep the round-2 code (the roster-derived intended-issues list in prepr step 7 and the X2 adjacency pin) intact; if a prepr step you did not touch is red on main, say so in the body rather than widening the diff.
Push handoff/r10-flow-jidoka then body_push.sh r10-flow-jidoka <body.md> (handoff-body/r10-flow-jidoka is the return signal). Do not move the head once pushed; a delta review follows.

CARRIES (22, from the live roster; each must be answered item by item):

CARRY 1 of 22:
Pre-study: the Lean flow pre-study, section K2.

CARRY 2 of 22:
Self-test hygiene: (a) a new seat-selftest mutant in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py takes a per-file id (for example cloud_relay-1), never a new S number (the P6 convention), and sits inside the block of the instrument it tests, never appended at the file's end, so parallel additions touch different hunks; on 2026-10-21 three pull requests (R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, R10-CI-LAYOUT's PR G) each lost a code round to a content conflict there when main gained tick_loop mutants S31-S34. (b) A self-test builds any git repository through tests/throwaway_git.py, never a hand-built git init (a pusher-reap handoff was refused for exactly that in tools/audit/seat/pr_args.sh); run python3 tests/throwaway_git.py --check before the handoff. (c) Any new git push site is registered in PUSHERS in tools/audit/seat/ref_privacy.py in the same pull request, or ref_privacy refuses it (#2582's heartbeat push did). (d) The body's Red checks section answers every check red on main's ancestry, one line each (today nightly-status), or pr-contract refuses it (standing rule 22).

CARRY 3 of 22:
Revision 12, moved in revision 15: the orchestrator-added carry disposition ('Carry: dismissed: <reason>' or 'Carry: <group>', under the orchestrator identity, keyed to the verdict's head SHA, read back) is fly-in R10-FLY-CARRY-DISPOSITION, dispatched ahead of the finish-first list; this group keeps its prepr and roster-ref scope.

CARRY 4 of 22:
Triage P3 (s4): add the base-pinned replay to prepr. CI's policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script restore the checkers from the base (governance.yml 'Restore the check source from the base commit', decision 0013) and grade the pull request's tree with them; prepr 3e-3g runs the head's copy of the same graders and never the base's, so a PR that edits a checker or adds a pinned file passes locally and reddens in CI (#2609 round 2, ~1 h; #2529 policy-docs 'pinned tools/policy/agreement_restore.py is unregistered'). When PIN_TOUCHED=0, build a detached worktree at HEAD, overlay `pinned_paths .github/workflows/*.yml` from origin/main, and run policy_lint.mjs and the agreement and wave-script lanes there; print one `base-pinned replay` step line with the first refusal. Control: a fixture PR that adds a pinned file the base registry lacks must refuse locally; null control: a diff touching no pinned path skips the step with its reason; mutants: removing the overlay makes the fixture pass (the defect), and flipping the gate runs the step on an unpinned diff. Do not extend to jobs that run the head's copy (briefs already runs the head's).

CARRY 5 of 22:
Orchestrator 2026-10-22 21:39Z, another prepr-passes/CI-fails instance: #2625 (R10-RCA-BODY-LINT) head 10a490f9 went red in CI instrument-self-tests (job 120096849712) on `ref_privacy --check` refusing an unregistered push site added to tools/pr/prepr.sh. open_pr's prepr had passed the head. This is the third such instance on 2026-10-22, after #2622's wave-script agreement lane and r10-rca-body-lint's agreement lane. JIDOKA's prepr replay of the CI lanes must include instrument-self-tests' ref_privacy --check, or prepr must run it directly.

CARRY 6 of 22:
Owner ruling (tvofi, 2026-10-22, verbatim): "Make sure the JIDOKA group does not add the full ci suite to prepr, only quick checks. Otherwise it sort of defeats the purpose". Binding scope for this group's prepr replay of CI lanes: only quick, deterministic checks, the class that caught 2026-10-22's three prepr-passes/CI-fails instances. That means the base-copy (pinned) graders (agreement lane, check-wave-script, policy-docs), ref_privacy --check and tmp_paths --check, measured at seconds each. No test suite, no entities/features/mutation run, and nothing CI's heavy lanes own. The PR body states each added check's measured wall time and the total added to prepr, and refuses any addition over a budget it names. A lane too slow for that budget stays CI-only and is listed as such.

CARRY 7 of 22:
From #2625 (R10-RCA-BODY-LINT), RCA section 7: tools/pr/prepr.sh runs check-wave-script.mjs and the agreement lane from the branch copy, while governance.yml's wave-script job restores every pinned grader from the base before running them, so a branch that edits a pinned grader can pass prepr and go red in CI (P2a hit this). Fix shape is raise_red's: run the base's copy offline beside the branch's. Quick-check only (tvofi ruling: JIDOKA adds no full CI suite to prepr). Control: a branch editing a pinned grader so its base copy fails is refused by prepr.

Run it at each body push (cheap, body-only), as body_push.sh now does for the pr-body lint. Control: a handoff-body tip that fails figure_lint is refused at body push, not at open.

From #2629 (R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET), Friction: tools/pr/prepr.sh: cost: its agreement lane runs the branch copy only, so the base-copy run the dispatch asked for was hand-built from wave-script's restore step. It took about 5 minutes and one wrong pass, because `governance.yml` holds three `Restore the check source from the base commit` steps and the first match is not wave-script's.

NOT RUN` and `RESULT survivors=1` on every branch, this one included; the pin #2444 asked for no longer runs.

Instances 2026-10-23: ORCH-LEDGER (agreement, 3 unregistered), INPUT-STALENESS (10 unpinned), #2620 r5 (budget-raise-gate unnamed).

Add the call to --body-check; refuse on UNROUTED, say UNVERIFIED (never refuse) where it needs a token or an out-of-tree O-brief. First establish from carry_audit.py whether 'none' plus prose should read UNROUTED; if the parse over-fires, fix it in carry_audit.py (R10-FLY-CARRY-DISPOSITION owns that file) with a null control. Failing fixtures first: unrouted item refuses; routed and dismissed items pass; no carry section passes. Mutant: drop the call. ALSO build the parity test: the checks pr-contract.yml runs on a body (policy_lint --pr-body, carry_audit, budget_raise_gate justification, the agreement lane) are each run by --body-check or listed with a reason. The RCA for the class (P-N, P-F, P-Q) is owed beside the fix in its own seat.

tvofi 2026-10-24 recommendation (a) (owner accepted; CARDS.json (prestudy-mech, r10s6 scratch, not in the tree)): quiet output by default for tools/pr/prepr.sh. Default prints the MODE line, one line per step (name and ok or FAILED with the failing check name) and the last lines of any failing step, and writes the full output to a log whose path is printed; a verbose flag or environment variable restores the full stream. Keep every line a reader keys on: the MODE: SCOPED or MODE: FULL line, each failing check name, and the final summary. Control: a seeded red step shows its name and tail in quiet mode; the quiet and verbose runs agree on the exit code; each rule has a mutant. Share the flag convention with R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS so the instruments do not diverge.

Read section 4 of that body for the three requirements this fixer owes.

Name the 6 PRs and the rule hit each made (`node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs --stats --since v7.0.4`, with a token), then decide whether the keying rule or the gate changes. Fix the cause in this group or record a decision not to, with the numbers. Part of #2835.

GROUP BRIEF:
Error-proofing before handoff (Lean study K2). Of 133 blocked fix reviews in round 10, 25 were carry-missing: a finding with no destination, a fact tools/audit/carry_audit.py checks offline with its check subcommand and --body, and which pr-contract.yml already runs after the push. Add one prepr step that runs that same check on the body the fixer hands off, so the refusal lands before review instead of after it. Run the existing checker; add no new rule (decision 0012). Also report why the red-check answer arm of prepr (reds_line, gated before its call site) did not fire on the round's root-cause-unanswered and ci-red blocks, and fix the gate if it is a defect. Revision 8: pass carry_audit.py --roster-ref with the freshly fetched round roster branch (roster_lib.round_ref); the worktree's roster is not where fix-review step 10 looks, so an offline check passes a carry that is not on the roster branch. Controls: a fixture body whose carry exists only in the worktree roster is refused; a fixture body with an unrouted Forward-carry item is refused at the new step and passes once routed; the prepr self-test count rises by exactly the new arms; the step's mutant (step deleted) fails the self-test. Carry from #2528 (R10-PREPR-CAP): tools/pr/prepr.sh steps 3 to 3h run heavy work in the foreground, so a KILL or TERM to prepr during step 3h leaves the self-test or mutants drive running or deferred; the fix shape is closures-step-style background-and-trap for each heavy step.

FINISH: before the push, run the ratchet (tests/structure.py) and prepr as the roles say; no budget raise without the orchestrator's confirmation (stop and ask via SendMessage-equivalent: state it in the handoff body). No Claude footers, no host paths in anything pushed.
